verdict.rationale: WorkOS's SSO docs say the service works with any IdP that supports SAML or OIDC, and enterprise SSO is a core AuthKit feature. Hands-on community users praise how easy WorkOS's wizard makes SAML configuration for their enterprise customers. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace as supported connection types, and detailed evidence of the connection setup flow.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: This service is compatible with any IdP that supports either the SAML or OIDC protocols.
Full-fledged authentication platform, from your first user to enterprise single sign-on
We frequently have customers compliment us on how easy it is to configure SAML and SCIM, but it's really WorkOS's wizard that they are complimenting
